title: Creating an image for an image-based application
sectionTitle: Creating an image for an image-based application
shortDescription: Creating an image of a VM with an image-based application instance installed and uploading it to VK Cloud
metaDescription: Creating an image of a VM with an image-based application instance installed and uploading it to VK Cloud. Two methods are described: using Packer (recommended) and via the VK Cloud management console.
